A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same transformer-development study. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A–F support comparison despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v2 reports original transformer-training experiments, LLC trajectories, behavioral and structural analyses, seed replications, and robustness tests in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains original experimental results for language modeling and in-context linear regression, including appendix sensitivity analyses and one-layer language-model experiments.

M1.justification: The transformer architectures, losses, SGLD-based LLC estimator, and Gaussian-process plateau-identification procedure are retained. The estimator documentation and calibration revisions do not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the filtered Pile and synthetic in-context linear regression, including finite task-diversity settings and rescaled input/task distributions. The one-layer language-model experiments already appear in v2.

E2.justification: Appendix B.5 retains the comparison against Hessian trace and the three leading eigenvalues. The bigram and task-prior reference comparisons are also retained; no evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Tables 1–2 revise reported LLC-estimation settings. Table 1 replaces the inconsistently labeled two-layer localization entry 200 with gamma=100, matching the existing prose. Regression localization changes from epsilon*gamma/2=0.01 to gamma=13.3 at unchanged epsilon=0.0003. These are reporting revisions, without evidence that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The positional-embedding ablation, SGLD sensitivity sweeps, OOD tests, and attention/weight-collapse analyses are retained. Figure A.4's checkpoint caption is corrected to match its existing plot; it does not supply a new sensitivity experiment.

E5.justification: Both versions report five training seeds in Figure B.3 and retain the same SGLD chain counts, burn-in information, seeding practices, and standard-deviation reporting, including Figure B.2's error bars.

E6.justification: Figure 1's stage boundaries and loss/LLC changes are unchanged, as are the main and appendix experimental findings. The restyled Figure B.4 retains the same four Hessian curves. Revised hyperparameter entries and checkpoint attribution concern settings rather than new outcomes.

T1.justification: Appendix A.3 adds conditional computational-complexity reasoning, including O(S C T_SGLD log N) under a constant sampling-budget assumption. Appendix A.5.3 changes the localization conversion from tilde-gamma=epsilon*gamma/2 to epsilon*gamma/4. The LLC volume asymptotics are largely relocated from Section 4 to Appendix A.1.

C1.justification: The title replaces 'degeneracy drives' with 'degeneracy and,' softening causal framing. The abstract and introduction more explicitly present the link as suggestive evidence for a hypothesis. The central empirical claim that LLC stages coincide with structural and behavioral changes remains.

C2.justification: Appendix C.1.3 explicitly clarifies that a more negative ICL score need not indicate better absolute performance on later tokens. Section 6.2 adds qualifications about interpreting positional ablation across architectures. The substantial causality limitations in Section 8 and Appendix D.2.6 already existed in v2.

D1.justification: v3 explicitly documents BOS-prefixed n-gram scoring contexts in Section 6.2 and the additional weight-copy memory requirement in Appendix A.3. Tables 1–2 revise estimator hyperparameter documentation. Code access, training hardware, and reported training times are retained.

R1.justification: v3 adds Odonnat et al. (2024), Clustering Head, to Section 2 and the references. It also cites the already included Chen and Edelman studies in Section 2. Other bibliography revisions mainly update formatting or publication metadata.

P1.justification: The main section sequence and Appendices A–F remain intact. Local revisions affect the title, author information, introduction, and selected explanations; the formal LLC definition moves into a new Appendix A.1. Most prose and narrative organization are retained.

P2.justification: The TMLR template changes typography, title/author layout, headers, and figure/table placement throughout the document, with several existing appendix figures placed on separate pages. Tables 1–2 are reformatted, Figure A.4's caption is corrected, and Figure B.4 is reduced in size and loses its training-step axis label.

improvement.justification: v3 better aligns its causal framing with limitations already acknowledged in v2, clarifies ICL interpretation and n-gram scoring, and resolves internal inconsistencies in Table 1 and Figure A.4's caption. The experimental evidence is unchanged. Some presentation changes, particularly the smaller Figure B.4 and missing axis label, reduce readability, but the clarification and consistency gains support a modest overall improvement.
